snippet.title: KAERUN – Official Coming Soon Trailer | Archaeological Exploration Adventure.
snippet.description:
For centuries, the stone chambers of Veyrland have stood in silence.

In **Kaerun**, you step into the role of a young archaeologist exploring the landscapes of Asterveen. Follow forgotten paths, investigate ancient discoveries, study what remains, and uncover the connection between a lost people and the mysterious stone chambers they left behind.

But some things were never meant to stay forgotten.

Every discovery brings you closer.  
Every chamber raises new questions.

**What happened here? And why are the stones awakening now?**

Kaerun is a 3D archaeological exploration and puzzle adventure focused on discovery, environmental storytelling, research and mystery.

🔹 Explore the open landscapes of Asterveen  
🔹 Investigate archaeological discoveries  
🔹 Piece together evidence through your Journal  
🔹 Solve ancient Stone Chamber puzzles  
🔹 Uncover the forgotten history of Veyrland

**KAERUN — Explore. Discover. Understand.**

Coming Soon on Steam.  
Wishlist Kaerun to follow its development.

Developed by **Moorstone Studios** as an independent passion project.

#Kaerun #IndieGame #IndieDev #Archaeology #PuzzleGame #ExplorationGame #UnrealEngine #MoorstoneStudios
